name: Extra Domain Filters
description: Enhance domain.com.au with extra filters to empower your search.
author: Niclas Rogulski

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names extension,auth,site "npm run dev:extension" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:site"
scripts.build:hosting: npm run build:site && npm run build:auth
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:hosting && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.eslint: eslint src manifest.config.ts vite.config.ts vite.auth.config.ts vite.site.config.ts eslint.config.js lint-staged.config.js
scripts.eslint:fix: eslint src manifest.config.ts vite.config.ts vite.auth.config.ts vite.site.config.ts eslint.config.js lint-staged.config.js --fix
scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run eslint && npm run stylelint
scripts.fix:all: npm run eslint:fix && npm run stylelint:fix
